description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementSearchFilterParams class, which extends DateRangeSearchFilterParams and provides filtering parameters for searching leave entitlements within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for employee number(s), leave type ID, and deletion status, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to specify filtering criteria for leave entitlement searches, including employee identifiers, leave type, and deletion status, with a predefined sort field.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Returns the leave type ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Sets the leave type ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeDeleted
methods.description: Returns the deletion status filter for leave types.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeDeleted
methods.description: Sets the deletion status filter for leave types.
